note: Landmark registry for ULAANBAATAR 6. Each part points at a real footprint in the Overture/OpenStreetMap data by its id. 'verified' lists facts that come from a cited source. 'approximated' lists everything the procedural stand-in guesses. None of these is an accurate 3D model. To replace a landmark with an authored model, set 'model' to a glTF path under mobile-prototype/public/landmarks/ (see docs/LANDMARKS.md).

sukhbaatar_square.name: Сүхбаатарын талбай
sources: Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0 land_use (OpenStreetMap, ODbL): plaza polygon, 32,275 m2
verified: Outline and position of the square (source polygon)
Position of the Government Palace on its north side (source footprint)
approximated: Paving pattern
Equestrian statue of D. Sukhbaatar: it is not in the source data; it is placed at the centre of the plaza polygon as a simplified block figure on a pedestal, size estimated

Roof shape, window layout and all ornament

shangri_la.name: Шангри-Ла
sources: Overture Maps 2026-10-21.0 buildings 8a90698c (135 m, 35 floors), 2ed0ab9c (108 m, 24 floors), 9107aebc (25 floors), 5ca566a0 (complex outline) (OpenStreetMap, ODbL)
Wikipedia 'Shangri-La Ulaanbaatar Complex': hotel tower 91.5 m / 24 floors, office tower 108 m / 24 floors, third tower 120-129 m (the article contradicts itself), five-storey mall in the base
verified: Tower heights 135 m and 108 m as recorded in the source; 108 m also matches Wikipedia
approximated: The 135 m source height for the tallest tower differs from Wikipedia (120-129 m); the source value is used
Hotel block drawn at 91.5 m (Wikipedia Tower A); matching that figure to footprint 9107aebc is an assumption
Complex outline 5ca566a0 is tagged 25 floors in the source; it is drawn as the five-storey mall podium (22.5 m), which is an interpretation
All facades: plain extrusions with a generic glass pattern
